expectations.text: Writes each entry note as a routing signal describing what the reader will find, not as marketing copy
expectations.evidence: Every link description states page contents, not product virtues: "Events, properties, users, and the data pipeline, in one page", "`identify`, anonymous-to-known merge, and alias resolution", "Auth, rate limits, and base URLs", "Browser install, autocapture, and manual event tracking", "What not to send, redaction, and retention controls". No adjectives of praise (no "powerful", "seamless", "best-in-class"); each is a terse noun-phrase index of topics, which is exactly the routing-signal form. The only near-misses are functional rather than promotional: the Quickstart's "in under 10 minutes"
